title: Vision Discount Levels Across the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships
content:
# Vision Discount Levels

Vision discounts are part of a Dental and Vision Savings Membership only where the membership includes vision. Each vision percentage is a whole-number percent off; a percentage is 0 when vision is not included.

| Membership | Vision included | Eye exams | Frames and lenses (eyewear) | Contact lenses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Smile Savings Individual | No | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Cascade Smile Savings Household | No | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual | Yes | 30% | 35% | 15% |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Household | Yes | 30% | 35% | 15% |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual | Yes | 35% | 40% | 20% |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Household | Yes | 35% | 40% | 20% |

## Notes to the table

1. The two Cascade Smile Savings memberships do not include vision; their eye exam, eyewear and contact lens percentages are 0.
2. The four Cascade Smile & Sight Savings memberships include vision. Frames and lenses share one percentage; contact lenses carry their own.
3. Within each Smile & Sight family pair, the Individual and Household memberships carry the same vision percentages.

## Basis questions

**Does a Cascade Smile Savings Household membership carry a discount on eyeglass frames?** No. Vision is not included in that membership, and its eyewear percentage is 0.

**Which percentage applies to contact lenses on a Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual membership?** The contact lens percentage of 20 percent, not the eyewear percentage of 40 percent.
